one_line: We would have to rent and clean standard portable toilets on Cape Cod over the long term. That is outside our trailer fleet, our NAICS/PSC codes, and our price list, and the bid is due in 4 days with the bid documents not yet in hand.
scope: The Town of Mashpee, MA Department of Public Works wants sealed bids to rent portable toilets and clean them on a schedule. Unit counts, locations, cleaning frequency, and contract term are in bid documents that are only available by emailing the DPW. None were attached to the bid pack.
fit: No set-aside (NONE), so our SBE/MBE status works and no 8(a)/WOSB/SDVOSB/HUBZone certification is needed.
Our core competencies list 'portable sanitation' under Facility Support & Utilities, and restroom facilities are in our fleet.

Related past performance: City and County of Denver, SC-00011558 (Aug 2026 – ongoing). We deliver and service climate-controlled restroom trailers there, including cleaning, pump-outs, waste disposal, supplies, maintenance, and demobilization.
New England past performance: Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Peterborough, NH (Nov 2022 – Nov 2023, about $130,000).
We already run weekly servicing (RCRA-compliant gray/black water removal, sanitizing, consumables) and cover the whole country.
red_flags: Product mismatch: they asked for portable toilets, not the restroom/shower trailers we rent. Our price list has no portable toilet line.
NAICS 562991 and PSC S216 are not among our codes (our NAICS are 721310, 532490, 722310, 624230, 624221, 561210, 423740, plus possibly 532120; our PSCs are W023, W099, W045).
Response deadline is 2026-11-18, 4 days from today. We have not received the bid documents and must request them by email first.
Sealed bid with no COMMBUYS submission ('DO NOT SUBMIT BID VIA COMMBUYS'). Delivery method is unknown and may need physical delivery from California.
The job is recurring cleaning in Mashpee, MA. Our profile shows no depot or pump-truck capability in Massachusetts, so local haulers will likely have a big cost advantage.
A comparable Massachusetts job (Portable Latrine Services, Devens RFTA, MA) drew 18 offers.
The bid pack has no attachments, so terms, bonding, insurance, and license requirements are unknown.
competition: No incumbent identified. The bid pack found no past Town of Mashpee awards under NAICS 562991. Closest benchmark: Portable Latrine Services, Devens RFTA, MA, awarded 2026-03-20 to Louis Unlimited Prosperity for $69,952 with 18 offers (small business set-aside). Other portable toilet awards: Gettysburg NMP seasonal and special-event portable toilets, Associated Products Services, $29,135, 4 offers; Suisun Bay Reserve Fleet portable toilets and handwashing stations, M & M Sanitary, $52,810, 7 offers. Most other benchmarks are federal vault-toilet or septic pumping, which is not comparable.
price_signal: HigherGov estimates the value at $15,000–$120,000. Comparable portable toilet awards: Devens RFTA, MA, $69,952 for 12 months (2026-03-22 to 2027-03-21); Gettysburg seasonal, $29,135 (Apr–Nov 2026); Suisun Bay, CA, $52,810 (base plus options, 2022–2027). We have no portable toilet unit price. Our smallest restroom unit, the 13ft Luxury Shower-Restroom Combination Trailer (3 stalls), is listed at $2,995–$3,995 depending on duration, and the billing basis is not stated. We cannot price this from our current price list.
